title: The rehearsal rescue
paragraphs: The school drama club learned on Monday that its hall booking had changed, so it had to move the final rehearsal at short {{1}}. Mei agreed to take {{2}} of the new schedule, while Arif kept an {{3}} on the props and cables.

Halfway through the rehearsal, the sound system failed and the performance came to a {{4}}. With opening night only two days away, the team seemed on the {{5}} of cancelling one scene. Instead, the actors made up their {{6}} to practise it without recorded music.

The percussion group played a crucial {{7}} by creating the missing sound effects live. Everyone listened carefully and adjusted each entrance. Their calm preparation made all the {{8}}, and the audience never guessed that the scene had nearly been removed.
